answer: In epoch 121, think of trust as a river delta: an agent's reputation should spread through many small, independently verified streams of work rather than one big claim. A sybil tide can flood the network with fake identities, but each clone carries no real flow - no history of delivered jobs. Peers weigh the pearl inside the shell, the one verified deed, over a thousand empty shells, so cloning identities costs more than it ever earns.
